title: The natural rate and the expectations-augmented Phillips curve: quotations of Friedman (1968, 1976), Phelps (2006), Modigliani and Papademos (1975), Gordon and King (1982), the Economic Report of the President (2000, tables B-40 and B-62), the Economic Planning Agency's annual report of 1974, the e-Stat listings and terms, and the records of the persons named
source: aeaweb.org (AER 58(1), 1968); nobelprize.org (Friedman 1976, Phelps 2006); brookings.edu (BPEA 1975(1), 1982(1)); govinfo.gov (ERP 2000); www5.cao.go.jp (年次経済報告 昭和49年); e-stat.go.jp; cao.go.jp; digital.go.jp; id.loc.gov; lobid.org (GND)
series: id, dynasty (the country), year, year_note, value (the numbers the quotation prints, ';'-separated, read by checks/check_ch44.py), unit, numeral, file (the key of the document in 'sources'), juan (the printed page and the PDF page, 'web page' or 'authority record'), quote (verbatim from the text layer, including its misreadings), note (what the row says)
license: Short quotations for teaching and criticism; no photographs are used. Friedman (1968) is © American Economic Association (rows f68_*); the AEA's copyright page (row aea_terms) says: 'Permission to make digital or hard copies for personal or classroom use of an American Economic Association publication, in part or whole, is granted without fee provided that copies are not distributed except for classroom use and that the first page includes the citation and appropriate copyright notice.' The book quotes short phrases only and paraphrases the rest. Friedman's Nobel lecture of 1976 (rows f76_*): 'Copyright © The Nobel Foundation 1976' (row nobel_f76_copyright); Phelps's lecture of 2006 (rows ph_*): 'Copyright © The Nobel Foundation 2006' (row nobel_ph_copyright). Modigliani and Papademos (1975) and Gordon and King (1982) (rows mp_* and gk_*) are © The Brookings Institution (the first page of the 1982 scan, as its text layer reads it: 'C)Brookinigs Institution', row gk_copyright); the terms of brookings.edu (row brookings_terms): 'All content included on this site, such as text, graphics, logos, button icons, images, audio clips, digital downloads, data compilations, and software, is the property of Brookings or its content suppliers and protected by all applicable proprietary rights laws.' Short phrases only. The Economic Report of the President (rows b40_*, b62_*) is a work of the United States government, in the public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105). e-Stat (rows lfs_*, cpi_* and the Japanese series of naturalrate_japan_1953_1986): '当サイトで公開している情報（以下「コンテンツ」といいます。）は、どなたでも以下の１）～６）に従って、複製、公衆送信、翻訳・変形等の翻案等、自由に利用できます。商用利用も可能です。' (row estat_free) 'また、数値データ、簡単な表・グラフ等は著作権の対象ではありませんので、これらについては本利用ルールの適用はなく、自由に利用できます。' (row estat_numbers) 'コンテンツを利用する際は出典を記載してください。' (row estat_source), e.g. '出典：「○○調査結果」（A省）' (row estat_example); 'コンテンツを編集・加工等して利用する場合は、上記出典とは別に、編集・加工等を行ったことを記載してください。' (row estat_edit), e.g. '「○○調査結果」（A省）を加工して作成' (row estat_edit_example). '本利用ルールは、政府標準利用規約（第2.0版）に準拠しています。' (row estat_standard) The annual economic report of 1974 of the Economic Planning Agency (rows wp_*) on the Cabinet Office site: '当ウェブサイトで公開している情報（以下「コンテンツ」という。）の著作権は、特記されていない限り内閣府に帰属し、権利表記の記載がない限り 公共データ利用規約（第1.0版）（デジタル庁） が適用されます。' (row cao_rule, 令和7年3月25日現在); the Public Data License 1.0: 'なお、数値データ、簡単な表・グラフ等は著作権による保護の対象ではありませんので、これらについては本利用ルールの適用はなく、自由に利用できます。' (row pdl_numbers) '本コンテンツを利用する際は出典を記載してください。' (row pdl_source) '…利用する場合は、上記出典とは別に、編集・加工等を行ったこと及びその主体を記載してください。' (row pdl_edit) The book names its sources as 出典：「労働力調査」（総務省統計局）、「消費者物価指数」（総務省統計局）を加工して作成, and 経済企画庁『昭和49年 年次経済報告』（内閣府ウェブサイト）. The authority records of the Library of Congress (rows loc_*) are public data; those of the GND (rows gnd_*) are served by lobid.org under CC0 1.0.
citation: Each row is cited to its document in the bibliography block of Chapter 44 (references_zh.tex): friedman1968, phelps2006, modigliani1975, gordon1982, erp2000, estatlfs, estatcpi, epa1974, loc44, gnd44; Friedman's lecture of 1976 is the shared item friedman1976. The e-Stat terms are cited with estatlfs and estatcpi, the Cabinet Office terms with epa1974, the AEA and Brookings terms with the works they cover.
notes: Every quotation is copied from the text layer of the document as data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py extracts it (pdftotext with and without -layout, tags removed from web pages, whitespace and Unicode compatibility forms normalized; the quotations of web pages keep the page's full-width forms), so the misreadings of the scans stay in the quotations; the rows say what each misreading stands for. The text layers of the AEA and Brookings scans join many words ('Traditionaland', 'sacrificeratio', 'unemploymentthat'). Named misreadings: 'onalyby' for 'only by' (f68_accelerating, f68_scan); 'acceleratin(ginflation' for 'accelerating inflation' (f68_accelerating); 'Tlhanks' for 'Thanks' (f68_wicksell); 'mnakethe' for 'make the' (f68_inflation2); 'WalshHealy' for 'Walsh-Healey' (f68_minimum); 'motneyby' for 'money by' (f68_peg_nominal); 'instrument-monetary' for 'instrument—monetary' (f68_topic); 'VolumeLVIII' for 'Volume LVIII' (f68_issue); 'Ml' for 'M1' (mp_m1target, mp_revised); 'MI' for 'M1' (gk_control); '51/2' for '5 1/2' (mp_55); '53/4' for '5 3/4' (mp_admin); 'Targets for in the Monetary Policy Coming Year' for 'Targets for Monetary Policy in the Coming Year' (mp_title); 'C)Brookinigs' for '© Brookings' (gk_copyright); 'Roth they' for 'Both they' (f76_workers); 'seriousIy' for 'seriously' (f76_error); 'Unemployement' as printed in Friedman's Table 1 (f76_t1head); '基づものく' as printed for '基づくもの' (wp_354); '7・4' as printed for '7.4' (wp_capacity). The numbers of rows mp_55 and mp_admin are read as 5 1/2 and 5 3/4, that of wp_capacity as 7.4 (checks/check_ch44.py, READINGS). Modigliani and Papademos: an unnumbered erratum slip (PDF p. 9, row mp_erratum) says that the vertical axis of Figure 1 on p. 148 is mislabelled and should read 'Change in the inflation rate'; inflation there is the change of the CPI excluding food (row mp_pcx). Friedman's text gives the last two quinquennia as '1966-70 and 1970-75' (row f76_one), his Table 1 as 1966 through 1970 and 1971 through 1975 (rows f76_t1966, f76_t1971); the book follows the table. Friedman's lecture quotes James Callaghan's speech of 1976 (rows f76_callaghan*); the speech itself was not read. Gordon and King report Okun's survey (Okun 1978, rows gk_okun, gk_okun_range); Okun (1978) was not read (FRASER did not answer on 2026-11-12). The web pages of NobelPrize.org, brookings.edu, aeaweb.org, e-Stat, the Cabinet Office, the Digital Agency and the authority records change from time to time (dates, scripts, record updates): a different hash of one of them is reported by data/fetch/naturalrate44.py but does not stop it; the quotations are then checked by verify_web_quotes.py. The PDFs must keep their hashes.
